pages.text: $(d)Potions of Cell Growth$(), like Organic Substrate, has no effect when imbibed. It's more of a crafting ingredient than a potion.$(br2)These recipes allow you to $(9)improve your odds of getting certain rare Genes$().
A $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/cell)Cell$(/l) can be brewed into the Potion of Cell Growth to $(9)set the Potion to the Cell's entity type$().

From there, certain entity types have recipes to make $(d)Genetically Modified Cells$(), which are guaranteed to give a specific Gene.$(br2)However, there's a catch. They can $(o)only/$ be crafted in an $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/incubator_advanced)Advanced Incubator$(/l) at low temperature, and there's $(c)a chance of failure$().

A low-temperature Advanced Incubator takes a very long time, but can be accelerated using Overclockers.$(br2)Unfortunately, $(c)Overclockers lower your chances$() of success. $(9)Chorus Fruits$() increase it back, though!$(br2)Process the GM Cell through a $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/dna_extractor)DNA Extractor$(/l) to get the set Helix.
